newsitem.title: USA: Webco Europe plans $300 million systems.
newsitem.headline: Webco Europe plans $300 million systems.

text.p: Webco Europe S.A. said Tuesday it will form Webco Information Technologies Co Ltd, to be known as Webco's IT Group.

It said the IT Group plans to expand rapidly with acquisitions, joint ventures and possible mergers, and that one such opportunity being considered is a potential leveraged buyout worth $300 million of a U.S.-based information technologies company.
Webco is a high-tech holdings company publicly traded on the Luxembourg Stock Exchange.
